text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A after a gain, but later account movements do not prove that sale was right or wrong; I should make decisions based on the investment case, not comfort with a realized gain.","Holding through losses avoids impulsive reactions, but reluctance to admit a mistake should not keep me invested when the reasons for owning a stock have changed.","I should assess portfolio risk and progress toward my goals across all holdings, and review them at a planned interval rather than react to small monthly moves."]}
